remarks: A private waterfront escape on Holly Pond, available fully furnished for immediate occupancy through the end of April. Set within the coveted Noroton Manor Association, this charming coastal home offers 2,000 square feet across two levels, with sweeping water views from inside and out. The main level features a living room with FP, formal dining room, sunroom, updated kitchen, laundry and powder room, while upstairs offers three bedrooms, an office and full bath. Launch a kayak or paddleboard from the private dock, dine alfresco overlooking the water, or unwind on the porch swing as the sun sets across the pond. Association tennis courts and private water access complete the experience all just moments from downtown Darien, beaches, the YMCA, Metro-North and schools. An idyllic coastal retreat offering the perfect blend of privacy, convenience and effortless waterfront living.
